# Binance Red Packet & Square Comment-to-Earn Auto-Claimer

> Real-time Telegram channel monitor and automated redeemer for Binance Crypto Box (Red Packet) drop codes and Binance Square Comment-to-Earn reward posts using Telethon and Playwright.

## Project Overview
- **Name:** Binance Auto-Claimer (Red Packet & Square)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Mazonia/redpacket-claimer
- **License:** MIT
- **Runtime:** Python 3.10+
- **Core Dependencies:** `telethon`, `playwright`, `rich`, `pydantic`

## Key Capabilities
- **Real-Time Telegram Monitoring:** Telethon MTProto listener tracks drop channels and instant message groups for Crypto Box codes.
- **Automated Crypto Box Redemption:** Playwright automation inputs codes onto `binance.com/cryptobox`, clicks Claim, and opens the reward box.
- **Binance Square Comment-to-Earn:** Detects Binance Feed / Square posts, extracts answers enclosed in special symbols, fills the answer box, and submits.
- **Anti-Ban Protection & Cooldown Parser:** Parses exact lockout durations from Binance error dialogs, persists cooldown timestamps, and enforces circuit breakers after consecutive invalid codes.
- **In-Page Session Recycling:** Reuses the active browser page and input field without reloading heavy single-page apps, slashing bandwidth by 95% and accelerating claim speeds.
- **Network Resilience:** Fast-recovery reconnect ladder for unstable connections with a held drops queue to process drops received during brief disconnects.

## Quickstart & Installation

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/Mazonia/redpacket-claimer.git
cd redpacket-claimer

# Set up virtual environment
python -m venv venv
.\venv\Scripts\activate

# Install dependencies and Playwright Chromium
pip install -r requirements.txt
playwright install chromium

# Configure Telegram API credentials
copy .env.example .env
# Edit .env with TG_API_ID, TG_API_HASH, and CHANNELS

# Run initial setup to log into Binance once
python main.py --login

# Start autonomous claiming
python main.py
```
